Predicates:
OlympicGames(x) ::: x is the Olympic games.
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
Last(x) ::: x is the last.
Tokyo ::: Tokyo.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in y.
Premises:
OlympicGames(olympicGames) ::: The Olympic games is a sporting event.
Last(olympicGames) ∧ Tokyo(olympicGames) ::: The last Olympic games was in Tokyo.
WonMostMedals(unitedStates, tokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
SportingEvent(worldChampionships) ::: The world championships is a sporting event.
